title: Conditional probability, total probability and Bayes

steps.title: Conditional probability
steps.idea: Knowing that $B$ happened shrinks the space of outcomes to $B$.

experiment.label: Condition on B in the Conditional probability station

steps.title: Total probability
steps.idea: Split the space into hypotheses $H_1, \ldots, H_n$ and add up the paths that lead to $A$.

experiment.label: Watch the particles in the Bayes tree

steps.title: Bayes formula
steps.idea: After $A$ is observed, the weights of the hypotheses are updated.
formula: P(H_k \mid A) = \dfrac{P(H_k)\, P(A \mid H_k)}{\sum\limits_{i=1}^{n} P(H_i)\, P(A \mid H_i)}
steps.example: A student knows the answer with probability $p$ and otherwise guesses among 5 options. Given a correct answer, the chance that it was a guess is $\dfrac{1 - p}{4p + 1}$.
